name: shopos
description: ShopOS — horizontally scalable e-commerce microservices monorepo

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w packages/observability && npm run build -w packages/kafka-client && npm run build -w packages/jwt-verifier
scripts.build:services: npm run build -w services/auth-service -w services/user-service -w services/product-service -w services/review-service -w services/coupon-service -w services/notification-service
scripts.observability:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.observability.yml --profile observability up -d
